Advanced Rockwell Type Hardness Testing Machines
HR-521/523
 Advanced Rockwell Hardness Testing Machines
 Features
 Multiple test force generation for Rockwell, Rockwell Superficial and optional Brinell hardness*.
 Projected-nose indenter arm for easy reach of interior (min. 1.6"(40mm)/.86"(22mm)*) With optional diamond
 indenter (19BAA292).
 Closed Loop electronic test force control for accurate loading.
 Auto-stop elevation table and automatic preliminary test force loading provide consistent test force generation.
 Includes vee and flat avnils, test blocks, diamond and 1/16" carbide ball indenters.
